feature: A long edit plays, scrubs and edits without a stutter (pass 9)
summary: Trimming or undoing on the 6 minute edit while it plays now holds the window for less time: a trim 32 to 18 ms at worst, a trim on a picked clip 34 to 24, an undo on a picked clip 44 to 29. The first edit after you pick a clip no longer redraws the whole timeline twice. Nothing on screen looks different.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the 6 minute reference edit (Scripts/perf/reference-edit.sh 6).

try.do: Press Space to play the edit.
While it plays, drag the end of a clip just ahead of the playhead half a second shorter.
Click a clip on V1 so its sections fill the panel, press Space again, and trim it the same way.
Press Command Z, then B on the picked clip, then Command Z.

evaluate: Does a trim while it plays feel like it lands without the picture catching?
With a clip picked, does trimming it feel as smooth as trimming one that is not?
Do the clip bars, cuts and click ticks still follow every trim and undo, one frame after the picture at most?
rough: Bars still not reached, so this task stays open. Worst of three short speed walks: trim 18, undo 36, blade 89 with nothing picked (its first pick fills the panel), pick 43; with a clip picked, trim 24, blade 46 (26 and 33 in the other two runs, 28 in a fourth; pass 8 read 29 to 36 with one 44), undo 29, against a bar of 16 ms. Scrub 2 frames behind (bar 1); 1 dropped frame a minute (bar 0).

The edit's own frame is now about 11 to 19 ms. The longest frame after an edit is the timeline's own redraw a frame later (17 to 24 ms), where every clip bar in sight is built again because each one reads the whole document; handing each bar its own values is the next step.
Picking a clip still holds the window about 42 ms, and the first pick fills the panel over about half a second, one section a frame.
The click ticks still read the document themselves, a frame late. Handing them their ticks from the lane broke sliding a tick in a walk, for the second time, and the cause is not found.
No mock covers this. It is speed work, and nothing on screen changed.
